headline: HomeView能否让苹果在智能家居扳回一城
lead: 苹果智能家居新品HomeView据报将于周二发布，配备显示屏、A18芯片并整合Siri。在HomeKit与HomePod均未打开局面后，这款设备能否改变苹果在家居领域的边缘地位，关键不在一台硬件，而在生态整合与实际体验。

chapters.title: HomeView能否让苹果在智能家居扳回一城
chapters.angle: 苹果智能家居新品HomeView据报将于周二发布，配备显示屏、A18芯片并整合Siri。在HomeKit与HomePod均未打开局面后，这款设备能否改变苹果在家居领域的边缘地位，关键不在一台硬件，而在生态整合与实际体验。

sentences.text: 据彭博社的Mark Gurman披露，苹果将于周二发布一款名为HomeView的智能家居中枢。
Gurman将该设备描述为一款由Siri驱动、带屏幕并搭载A18芯片的产品，可让用户控制其他智能家居设备。
报道称HomeView将有两个型号，一款面向台面，另一款用于壁挂安装。
同日苹果还将更新Apple TV机顶盒与HomePod mini两款家居设备。

blocks.text: 据彭博社的Mark Gurman披露，苹果将于周二发布一款名为HomeView的智能家居中枢。Gurman将该设备描述为一款由Siri驱动、带屏幕并搭载A18芯片的产品，可让用户控制其他智能家居设备。报道称HomeView将有两个型号，一款面向台面，另一款用于壁挂安装。同日苹果还将更新Apple TV机顶盒与HomePod mini两款家居设备。

sentences.text: 报道指出，过去几年里苹果一直在研发一款新的智能家居产品，外界多次传出相关消息，但直到现在这款产品才有了名字和发布时点。
在HomeView之前，苹果在智能家居领域的两张牌——HomeKit软件框架和HomePod智能音箱——都没有获得多少市场反响。

blocks.text: 报道指出，过去几年里苹果一直在研发一款新的智能家居产品，外界多次传出相关消息，但直到现在这款产品才有了名字和发布时点。在HomeView之前，苹果在智能家居领域的两张牌——HomeKit软件框架和HomePod智能音箱——都没有获得多少市场反响。

sentences.text: HomeView的产品逻辑是把此前分散的能力收进一块带屏终端：由Siri承接语音交互，A18芯片提供本地算力，屏幕承担控制中枢的界面角色，双形态设计则试图同时覆盖固定墙面场景与移动台面场景，这与其说是新品类，不如说是对HomePod与HomeKit两条旧线索的合流。
但硬件规格本身并不解决苹果此前受挫的根因：HomeKit生态长期依赖第三方厂商配合，HomePod的销量也未形成足够装机规模，带屏中枢的价值取决于能接入多少设备、以及跨品牌控制是否稳定，这些都不是A18芯片或屏占比能直接回答的。

sentences.text: 从本次披露的节奏看，苹果准备的是组合拳而非单品：HomeView之外，同步更新Apple TV和HomePod mini，并据Gurman此前说法与LG合作打造智能锁、恒温器和门铃，这三条线索分别对应中枢、内容入口和第三方设备，构成一次家居战略的成建制推进。

sentences.text: 判断是：HomeView尚不足以让苹果在家居领域翻盘，它更像一次把旧资产重新打包的尝试，成败取决于生态接入和实际控制体验，而非发布本身。

events.title: The Preliminary Lunar Science Report for Artemis II is Out!
events.originalTitle: The Preliminary Lunar Science Report for Artemis II is Out!
events.excerpt: In addition, the Artemis II flight provided an opportunity for observation, science, and data gathering that has not existed since the Apollo Era. During the flight, the astronauts studied the "dark side's" geology, witnessed nighttime impacts on the surface, and watched the Earth and Sun rise from the far side of the Moon. And now, with the mission data processed, NASA has released "Artemis II: Sights & Sounds of Science, a field guide to the Artemis II Preliminary Lunar Science Report.

evidenceRecords.text: Through photographs, spoken observations, drawings, and annotations, the Artemis II crew created a unique scientific record—one that is now available to the science community and the public for further study.
In addition, the Artemis II flight provided an opportunity for observation, science, and data gathering that has not existed since the Apollo Era.
During the flight, the astronauts studied the "dark side's" geology, witnessed nighttime impacts on the surface, and watched the Earth and Sun rise from the far side of the Moon.
And now, with the mission data processed, NASA has released "Artemis II: Sights & Sounds of Science, a field guide to the Artemis II Preliminary Lunar Science Report.
Explore highlights here, and find the full suite of reports and select data resources at the bottom of the page.
Who can forget the lovely picture the Artemis II astronauts took of planet Earth on Day 2 of the mission?

But for mission scientists, it was more than a pretty picture; it captured active weather systems, auroras at both poles, distinct atmospheric layers, a Saharan dust plume, zodiacal light, and city lights on the surface.
While Earth-observation satellites are crucial to science, they observe the Earth in strips rather than getting a holistic view.
Captured by the Artemis II crew during their lunar flyby on April 6, 2026, this image shows the Moon fully eclipsing the Sun.
Credit: NASA
Per the mission plan, lunar scientists asked the Artemis II crew to use the nearly hour-long total solar eclipse as they passed the Moon’s far side.
The observed flashes coincided with a planned communications loss as Integrity passed into the Moon's shadow.
The crew then sent the video they acquired to the Lunar Science Team at NASA's Johnson Space Center Mission Control Center in Houston (shown in the video above).
That data is essential to the Artemis program and its long-term objective of creating lunar habitats that will enable long-term operations on the lunar surface.
Credit: NASA Per the mission plan, lunar scientists asked the Artemis II crew to use the nearly hour-long total solar eclipse as they passed the Moon’s far side.

displayTranslation.title: 阿尔忒弥斯二号初步月球科学报告发布
displayTranslation.summary: 阿尔忒弥斯二号飞行提供了自阿波罗时代以来未曾有过的观测、科研和数据收集机会。飞行期间，宇航员研究了“背面”地质，观测到月表夜间撞击，并从月球远端观看地出和日出。随着任务数据完成处理，NASA发布了《阿尔忒弥斯二号：科学景象与声音——阿尔忒弥斯二号初步月球科学报告野外指南》。

events.title: Will the HomeView be Apple’s first smart home success?
events.originalTitle: Will the HomeView be Apple’s first smart home success?
events.excerpt: Over the past couple of years, we’ve seen multiple reports that Apple was working on a new smart home product, but now it seems the product has a name and a launch date. Apple will announce a new smart home hub on Tuesday called the HomeView, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. Gurman described the HomeView as a Siri-powered device with a display and an A18 chip, allowing customers to control their other smart home devices.

evidenceRecords.text: Over the past couple of years, we’ve seen multiple reports that Apple was working on a new smart home product, but now it seems the product has a name and a launch date.
Apple will announce a new smart home hub on Tuesday called the HomeView, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman.
Gurman described the HomeView as a Siri-powered device with a display and an A18 chip, allowing customers to control their other smart home devices.
The HomeView will reportedly be available in two models — one designed for countertops and the other to be mounted on walls.
This would be Apple’s most serious bet on the smart home to date, after it failed to get much traction for its HomeKit software framework or its HomePod smart speaker.
Gurman reports that on Tuesday, Apple will also be unveiling updated versions of two other home devices, namely the Apple TV set-top box and the HomePod mini.
Earlier this week, he said that Apple plans to announce a partnership with LG to create a smart lock, a thermostat, and a doorbell.

topicPlan.title: 阿尔忒弥斯二号科学成果意味着什么
topicPlan.angle: 阿尔忒弥斯二号初步月球科学报告发布，回答了载人绕月飞行在科学观测上留下了什么、为何值得现在梳理、以及这些数据对后续登月任务意味着什么。证据来自乘组拍摄照片、口述观察、绘图与标注形成的独特科学记录，以及自阿波罗时代以来首次获得的对月背地质、夜间撞击和地月升落的观测机会。
